notes: WArmy 0.4.24 — cross-view UI-state isolation round (R229): expanding or collapsing the "Docked devices" group (or the default group) in My Workhorses no longer syncs to Projects — the second-column group collapse memory was a single global object keyed only by group id, shared by all four list views (My Workhorses / Projects / Group chats / Contacts); it is now keyed per view with a one-time migration of the old flat format, so each view keeps its own expand/collapse choices. The same class of bleed was found and fixed in two more places: the temporary collapse-all snapshot taken while dragging a session between groups now records its owning view and only restores that view on drop, and the fourth-column card section collapse memory (file categories / knowledge categories etc.) was keyed by card+section only, so collapsing a section in a workhorse chat also collapsed the same-named card section in a project chat — it is now keyed by layout kind (single/internal) + card + section, also with a one-time migration. Verified by a 40-assertion real-machine probe (full first-run registration chain, seeded workhorse/project/group/contact records, real clicks across all four views, drag-start/drag-end restore, and per-layout section collapse memory) plus the scoped suite: 16 gates x 3 consecutive clean rounds covering exactly the changed surfaces plus R224-R228 contract regressions. No UI string changes this round.
